lessons: CRITICAL fixed: customs core was inverted ($130 'raised via executive order Feb 25 2026'); the Knesset revoked the order and the threshold is back to $75 from June 2 2026. Rewrote Step 4, Gotchas, and Examples to $75. The 2026 history (150 proposed -> 130 transitional 25.02-01.06 -> 75 restored) is volatile; re-verify the active threshold against Tax Authority / kolzchut on every future cycle.
Fixed: in-store return is 14 days (not 7) under takanot bitul iska for electronics; reframed as statutory.
Fixed: '3 interest-free payments over 500 NIS' was framed as a law; it is a market norm, corrected.
Fixed: electronics warranty legal responsibility is on the importer/manufacturer (over 150 NIS), not the retailer.
Coverage added: Google Shopping IL as a second aggregator; Amazon has no local .co.il store; gray-market/parallel-import warranty caveat.
Deferred (MINOR, Phase 4.1 batch cap): add Wisebuy as a 'which model' research source and max PayBack / Isracard issuer-cashback cards to the savings workflow. Revisit next cycle.

Retailer existence re-verified: Bug is OPERATING (no closure), Be/bestore is Shufersal-owned. 'Sham Ze Zol Yoter' extension could not be independently confirmed; softened to 'verify before recommending'.
Expert CRITICAL fixed: clarified the two bases, the $75 exemption is judged on goods value only, but once over $75 the 18% VAT base is the full CIF (goods+shipping+insurance) from the first dollar.

Expert MAJOR fixed: in-store return is gated on 'not damaged' (original-packaging is a safe-harbor, not a precondition); added who bears return-shipping cost; added courier customs-clearance/handling fees to the landed-cost model.

Deferred (MINOR, Phase 4.1 cap): add an import caveat for plug/voltage (Type-H, 110V), Hebrew-UI/local cellular-band compatibility; add a 'last verified' date to fixed numbers (VAT 18%, AC install 400-800 NIS, BTU table); have Step 7 surface a refurbished/open-box and net-of-trade-in price tier. Revisit next cycle.

CARRY RESOLVED: the volatile personal-import threshold was re-verified as instructed. It is still $75 and nothing changed after 02.06.2026. Source (Kol Zchut zchuton, page itself updated 16.08.2026, 11 days before this cycle) states the $130 window in the past tense with a closed 25.02-01.06.2026 range. Negative control confirmed the host returns a real 404 on a bogus path, so the 200 is meaningful.

CRITICAL fabricated citation: evidence claim personal-import-tiers-2026 carried the raw_snippet 'התעריף הסטנדרטי של מכס הוא כ-12%' presented as verbatim from the Kol Zchut page. The strings 12%, סטנדרטי and התעריף הסטנדרטי are ALL absent from that page. The self-consistency gate had passed it because the number appeared in both the skill and the invented snippet. The 12% figure is removed from the skill rather than re-sourced. Two more entries (online-return-14-day-14c, instore-return-bitul-iska-14-day) had the same defect and were repaired with real page text.

CRITICAL coverage: the tier table had 3 tiers where the source has 4. Added the $500-1,000 band (VAT, with customs/purchase tax only for some) and the >$1,000 band, where the shipment is taxed as a COMMERCIAL importer is taxed, as are tobacco and alcohol at any value. The old text said 'above $500 full customs + VAT + purchase tax' and applied a flat 18-30% rule of thumb to everything above $75, which understated the most expensive cases.

CRITICAL omission: the 72-hour split-shipment anti-avoidance rule was entirely absent, while Step 4 told the agent to 'always check AliExpress' for anything under $75. That combination actively invites a user into splitting an order, which does not work: parcels from one supplier to one customer under 72 hours apart are aggregated. Added the rule and rewrote the recommendation so it cannot be read as advice to split.
Added the exchange-rate basis (Bank of Israel representative rate plus 0.5%), which a landed-cost skill had been silent on.

WRONG DESTINATION, Hebrew only: SKILL_HE.md sent users to mhashmal.co.il for Machsanei Hashmal. That domain belongs to a different company entirely (דהן אלקטריק, an electrical contractor). machsaneihashmal.co.il has no DNS record at all. The real site is payngo.co.il (Electra Consumer Products, chain founded 1993, acquired 2007). EN named the chain with no URL. Both languages now carry payngo.co.il plus an explicit warning not to guess the domain from the name.

iDigital was described as also carrying Samsung, Bose and other premium brands. It is Apple-only (33 Apple hits on the live homepage, 0 for Bose). Worse, Example 1 explicitly routed a Samsung Galaxy shopper to iDigital, i.e. to a store that does not stock the product. Fixed the description and the example.

LastPrice was listed under price tracking as an 'alternative price comparison site'. It is an online RETAILER. An agent told to cross-check Zap against it compares an aggregator to a single vendor and reports a false consensus.

Unsourced specifics removed or softened: TopCash 'via American Express' (no trace on the site), the KSP price-match 'guarantee' and its 'Daily Deals' section (neither confirmable; KSP's actual outlet section is מציאון ועודפים), Bug's 'computer components / used-refurbished' specialism (contradicted by its live catalogue), and the Cashback.co.il superlative, now attributed as the vendor's own claim.

The anti-bot Gotcha named the wrong hosts. Zap, Ivory, Bug, iDigital, Home Center, ACE and IKEA all answer normal requests; only KSP and payngo.co.il return 403. The old text told the agent to give up on the primary Zap workflow it can actually perform.

The gov.il reference row promised 'exemption thresholds' from a hub page that carries no dollar figures at all. Repointed, with a note that gov.il 403s plain fetches and that a dead page can hide behind that 403.

SELF-INFLICTED, caught by the legal tripwire: an idiomatic Hebrew phrase I wrote, 'חוות דעת שנייה' (second opinion), tripped verify_legal.py's tribunal-document signal and pushed the skill from level=2 clear to level=3 REVIEW. Baseline comparison against the pre-edit tree identified it. Reworded; note the gate reads idioms literally.

Deferred (MAJOR, next cycle): Temu and Shein are absent from a 2026 import-vs-local skill, and TopCash's own live merchant list shows Temu at the highest cashback rate on the page, above AliExpress. Also still deferred from 1.2.0: Wisebuy as a model-research source, plug/voltage (Type-H, 110V) and Hebrew-UI/cellular-band import caveats, 'last verified' dates on the frozen numbers, and a refurbished/open-box tier in Step 7. The AC install range and BTU table in Example 2 still carry no evidence entry.
Phase 5.7 not run: the description and trigger surface were unchanged.
